schemeScope: Combined Higher scheme LC001ALP000EV (named EV, printed in Irish). PDF 14–15 Ceist 1 Prós (A: (a) three alternatives "Ionramháil Ábhair = 22 marc", (b) two "= 13 marc", "Cumas Gaeilge – (a) agus (b) le chéile = 5 marc"; B the same, each alternative with its title line, then "C. 1 (A) nó (B) = 40 marc (22 + 13 + 5)", the examiner’s note and the title rule); PDF 16 Ceist 2 Próstéacs Breise ("{ Ionramháil Ábhair = 35 marc} { Cumas Gaeilge = 5 marc}") and Ceist 3A; PDF 17 Ceist 3B; PDF 18 Ceist 3C, Ceist 3’s "Cumas Gaeilge (A nó B agus C le chéile) = 10 marc" and Ceist 4 Stair ("13 + 12 (Eolas) móide 5 marc ar an gCumas Gaeilge (sa dá cheann le chéile) = 30 marc"). Páipéar II prints no supporting notes, band table or grade-to-mark table. PDF 3–13 belong to Páipéar 1, PDF 19–30 to the aural test, PDF 31–32 are blank.
reviewMethod: Every paper page (1 cover, 2 the Treoracha, 3–15 the questions and poems, 16 blank) and scheme PDF 14–18 read in the text layer and checked against the rendered page; each prompt line and scheme slice is asserted against the PDFs by the builder.

nonPoolDecisions: One card per printed route: Ceist 1 A (Prós Ainmnithe) and B (Prós Roghnach); Ceist 2 A(a), A(b), B(a), B(b), C(a), C(b), D(a), D(b); Ceist 3 A, B and C; Ceist 4. 14 cards.

A printed choice inside a route is one card: Ceist 1A(a)’s three texts and 1A(b)’s two questions, 1B(a)’s three optional texts and 1B(b)’s two questions, each Ceist 2 route’s (i) and (ii), 3A(a)’s two poems, 3A(b)’s two questions, 3B’s alternatives and 3C’s two poems are marked alike by the scheme and file under one Atlas heading (pre-2012 texts have no Atlas node of their own).

The scheme prices each answer with one Eolas figure and prints no scale for it (no band table, grade table or notes on Páipéar II): each judged answer is claimed whole. Where a criterion prints its alternatives each at that figure ("(Lá Buí Bealtaine) Ionramháil Ábhair = 22 marc Nó … = 22 marc"), each alternative is a row of its own at the full figure and the one answered is claimed (tariffs.ts parsePrintedAlternatives); an alternative printed again in the same words (3C(ii) "Mínigh na línte") is one row.
Ceist 2’s Eolas criterion reads "Ionramháil Ábhair = 35 marc" as printed inside its braces; the selection line before it and the Cumas Gaeilge rule after it are the Gaeilge criterion’s guidance.
Ceist 3’s Cumas Gaeilge is 10 for A or B and C together; each route card carries 5, its printed 35 less its printed Eolas 30, and says so.

Ceist 4 is one card: Eolas 25 and Cumas Gaeilge 5. The Eolas row is the scheme’s "Dhá cheann le déanamh as (a), (b), (c), (d), (e), (f). 13 + 12 (Eolas)", stepped only at the split it prints (0, 12, 13, 25); the "= 30 marc" total and the full rule are on the Gaeilge criterion.
sourceFindings: Pre-2012 layout: the reading comprehension is in Páipéar 1; Páipéar 2 is literature and Stair na Gaeilge. Existing Atlas entries for this paper are section keys (1, 2, 3, 4, P-A, P-B, F-A, F-B, X); the route cards take P-A, P-B, F-A and F-B over (the 2010–2011 keys the crosswalk files on the prescribed and optional shelves) and add F-C (Dánta Dualgais Breise), X-2A-a … X-2D-b and X-4 beside them, as 2011.

Paper variants, kept as printed: 3C(a)(ii) quotes the poem’s last verse as "más cinniúin domh", "gealladh domh" and "fán tSeanainn" where the poem (PDF 13) prints "damh" and "fan"; the question names the poem "Úirchill a’ Chreagáin", its printed title "ÚIRCHILL AN CHREAGÁIN".

Scheme variants beside the paper (the cards show the paper’s question): 3A’s heading "(35 marc)" for the paper’s "35 mharc"; "Níl aon Ní" for "Níl Aon Ní"; 1B(a) "(Scéil béaloidis)"; 3C(b)(ii) "Mínigh na línte" without the full stop that (a)(ii) prints.
Ceist 3’s note prints "an marc as 17 (Ábhar) agus as 13 (Ábhar) agus as 30 (Ábhar) agus as 10 (Gaeilge)": 17 is A or B’s (a) (11 + 6), 13 its (b), 30 C (18 + 4 + 8).
The paper’s SymbolMT dashes (U+F02D) flank the boxed headings and print three dashes inside the poems; read as U+2212. The scheme’s Páipéar II pages print no symbol-font span.
